home.title: Regeneration begins long before you fall asleep.
home.subtitle: SomnoBalance is not a mattress brand. It's a ritual for the transition into rest — sensory, unhurried, and built around you.

about.title: About
about.heading: The SomnoBalance principle
about.p1: SomnoBalance is a regeneration and lifestyle brand. Our products — mattresses, pillows, oils, tea, and ritual cards — are tools within a holistic system, not the offer itself. The promise underneath all of it is simple: regeneration, calm, quality of life.
about.p2: We deliberately take a different path from high-tech, sleep-tracking approaches. There is no dashboard here, no score to optimise. SomnoBalance is holistic, sensory, and ritual-based — a point of difference, not a gap.
about.p3: The system moves through four phases — REGULATE, LET GO, PREPARE, REGENERATE — each paired with its own ritual, its own products, and its own place in an evening.
about.craftCopy: SomnoBalance draws on more than 35 years of experience developing sleep-environment products. That heritage sits quietly behind the brand — see our {impressumLink} for the full legal detail.

forMe.title: A ritual that eases your transition into the night.
forMe.p1: SomnoBalance was built for the moments between the end of the day and the start of sleep — for confident women navigating change in how they rest, with the standards to expect something considered, not clinical.
forMe.p2: Regeneration and sleep concerns touch nearly everyone — this space is built with that wider experience in mind, without losing the sensory, unhurried tone at its centre.

forBusiness.title: A home that gives your guests a sense of calm.
forBusiness.intro: For hospitality and health-sector partners — boutique hotels, wellness resorts, and clinics — SomnoBalance brings a considered, guest-facing regeneration system into shared spaces.
forBusiness.card1Copy: Ritual sets for guest rooms — pillow, oil, and tea — presented as part of the stay.
forBusiness.card2Copy: Volume pricing and consistent supply for properties of any size.
forBusiness.card3Copy: The same calm, sensory language your guests already associate with rest.
forBusiness.cta: Talk to us about your property

partner.title: Shared values, transparent commission.
partner.intro: We work with health professionals — physiotherapists, alternative practitioners, kinesiologists, and others whose work touches regeneration and rest — who want to recommend something they believe in, on clear and fair terms.
partner.card1Copy: A clear percentage on every recommended sale, tracked and reported without ambiguity.
partner.card2Copy: No discount-driven marketing, no pressure tactics — recommendations that fit your practice.
partner.card3Copy: Live dashboard, track clicks, referred orders, commission payouts, and in-app alerts.

In-stock items (Ritual collection, cards, pillow, starter set) are dispatched immediately and generally arrive within 1–3 business days. Mattresses are made to order and take approximately 3–4 weeks to manufacture before they ship — mattresses from 160 × 200 cm arrive as 3–4 separate parcels.
Orders over €59 ship free of charge. For mattresses, shipping is always included in the price shown, regardless of order value.

Yes. As a consumer in the EU you have a 14-day right of withdrawal from the date of delivery, with no need to give a reason. See our Right of Withdrawal page for the full policy and a model withdrawal form. Separately, damaged or defective products are covered by our Refund & Return Policy, and a statutory 2-year warranty applies to defects present at delivery.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Card, SEPA Direct Debit, and PayPal, processed through our payment provider, Stripe. Card and bank details are never stored on our own servers.

items.q: Is SomnoBalance the same company as Willing1863?
items.a: SomnoBalance is the brand you experience. It is operated by Friedrich-Alexander Willing, trading as "Willing1863" — Willing1863 is named only for legal-disclosure purposes. Full legal detail is in our Impressum.

items.q: Do you offer wholesale or hospitality pricing?
items.a: Yes — see our For my business page or contact us directly to discuss terms for hotels and wellness properties.
